relevance_note: Single case report of a genetically confirmed Danon disease patient: "We report a case of DD in an adolescent male patient, confirmed by genetic testing".
method_note: Read by hand; no tables in the paper; output assembled with a short script from manually chosen spans. Single unnamed patient labelled 'patient' (rule 5). No LAMP2 variant description, zygosity or parental testing is printed (only 'gene sequencing'/'genetic testing'); kept one variant row with variant_original_string 'not reported' and gene 'LAMP-2' from the background sentence of the abstract. Age 18 is age at admission (recorded as last evaluation); onset age not stated (only 'three-year history'), not computed. Country of origin in the footnotes is the article's, not the patient's; not used. Normal findings ('normal development, intelligence, consciousness, and retinal features', 'muscle tone was normal', 'no pre-excitation') recorded as excluded abnormalities (D-27); 'normal retinal features' used to exclude the pigmentary retinopathy checklist item and 'normal development' the developmental delay item. Temporal changes, not contradictions: muscle strength level 5 and normal consciousness at first examination, later limb weakness (grade 1-4) and deep coma; checklist proximal muscle weakness set observed from the later weakness plus the authors' attribution to skeletal muscle damage (proximal distribution not stated). 'ventricular blocks' on ECG not mapped to atrioventricular block. 'non-obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy' used to exclude LVOT obstruction. Heart failure checklist observed from 'cardiac insufficiency' (authors also 'speculate' late-stage heart failure; that speculation not used). No contradictions found.
